readmeExcerpt: # OpenMinis **Your private, on-device AI agent.** OpenMinis brings leading models — Claude, GPT, Gemini and more — into a native mobile experience, and gives them a real computer to work with: a full Linux shell running on your device, browser automation, extensible skills, persistent memory, and deep system integration. It is free, and fully open source. **We believe that in the age of AI, technical design and code are no longer where a product's advantage lies. The best agent emerges from a tight feedback loop with the people who use it — their expectations and their reports are what converge on the product.** Official website: **[openminis.app](https://openminis.app)**   --- ## What it does | | | |---|---| | **Bring your own model** | Claude, GPT, Gemini and other providers, via your own API keys or account sign-in. | | **A real Linux shell** | A sandboxed Alpine Linux environment runs on-device — the agent can install packages, run scripts, and work with real files. | | **Device integration** | Health, Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, HomeKit, Bluetooth, Clipboard, Media, Alarms and more, exposed to the agent as tools. | | **Browser automation** | The agent can browse and interact with the web on your behalf. | | **Skills & memory** | Extensible skills plus persistent memory across sessions. | | **Workspaces** | Organise work into separate contexts, addressable via `minis://workspace/`. | | **Native offloads** | Heavy or platform-specific work is handed to native code instead of the sandbox. | --- ## What you can do with Minis A few things people actually use it for: - **Photograph a meal, log the nutrition** — Minis identifies the dishes, estimates calories and macros, and writes them to Apple Health. - **Wake up to your timeline** — Shortcuts triggers Minis to fetch your X timeline, summarise it, synthesise speech, and play it as your alarm. - **Turn group chatter into tasks** — pull messages from a Telegram group, extract bugs and action items, deduplicate them, and file them into Apple Reminders. - **Mount your Obsidian vault** — research, clean up and write Markdown notes back into the vault as a normal workspace. - **Share anything into a calendar event** — send a page or message to Minis via the iOS Share Sheet and it creates the event, time and place included. **→ [OpenMinis/AwesomeMinis](https://github.com/OpenMinis/AwesomeMinis)** — a curated, community-contributed collection of use cases and workflows across health, productivity, research, finance and developer tooling. --- ## Skills A **skill** is a folder with a `SKILL.md` file — instructions, and optionally scripts, references and assets — that the agent loads on demand when a request matches it. Metadata stays in context for triggering; the body and bundled resources load only when the skill is actually used. Minis has its own tool system, but it does not require skills written specifically for it: **skills built for Claude, Codex, OpenClaw or Hermes Agent generally run in Minis as-is.** Skills that have been adapted to Minis' tools simply run better — they can reach the Linux shell, device integrations and native offloads directly. **→ [OpenMinis/MinisSkills](https://github.com/OpenMinis/MinisSkills)** — skills adapted for Minis alongside ones built for it from scratch, covering TTS, search, media downloads, health analysis, cloud APIs and more. --- ## Press > "the most impressive indie app I've seen in a while" > > — Federico Viticci, [**Open Minis Is the iOS Agent I Wish Siri AI Could Be**](https://www.macstories.net/reviews/open-minis-is-the-ios-agent-i-wish-siri-ai-could-be/), > MacStories (July 2026) > "在很大程度上实现甚至局部超越了 Apple Intelligence" > > — Ye Han, [**这可能是 iPhone 最强 Agent 软件，没有之一 丨Open Minis 入门指南**](https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2045570157783807562), > 知乎 / Zhihu (June 2026) > "可能是 iOS 端最强 AI Agent" > > — [**Open Minis：可能是 iOS 端最强 AI Agent**](https://www.appinn.com/open-minis/), > 小众软件 / Appinn (March 2026) --- ## Beta programme App Store releases can lag behind: every update waits on review, and we hold builds back when stability warrants it. The TestFlight build is where fixes and new features land first. **→ [Join the TestFlight beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/3BdkA5c3)** On Android, the [releases page](https://github.com/OpenMinis/OpenMinis/releases) always carries the latest APK. --- ## Building from source Minis ships a Linux sandbox inside the app, so the native dependencies (iSH on iOS, PRoot on Android, FFmpeg, LAME) and the Alpine rootfs are **built from source** rather than committed as binaries. **→ See [BUILDING.md](BUILDING.md) for the full first-build guide.** The short version: ```sh git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/OpenMinis/OpenMinis.git cd OpenMinis # iOS — order matters: FFmpeg links against LAME ./deps/build_lame.sh && ./deps/build_ffmpeg.sh ./deps/build_ish.sh && ./deps/prepare_alpine_rootfs.sh open src/ios/Minis.xcodeproj # Android — needs NDK r28+ ./deps/build_proot.sh && ./scripts/prepare_android_sandbox.sh cd src/android && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug ``` `BUILDING.md` covers the toolchain requirements per platform, the build-time customization templates, and a troubleshooting section for the failure modes you are most likely to hit. --- ## Repository layout ``` src/ios/ iOS app (Swift / SwiftUI) + share, widget and file-provider extensions src/android/ Android app (Kotlin / Compose) + JNI native code src/shared/ Assets shared by both platforms deps/ Native dependency build scripts and vendored sources docs/specs/ Architecture and interface specifications scripts/ Rootfs preparation and developer tooling ``` --- ## Acknowledgements OpenMinis stands on a great deal of open-source work. Our thanks to the maintainers of these projects — the full inventory, with versions and license terms, is in [THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). **The sandbox** — the heart of the product: - **[iSH](https://github.com/ish-app/ish)** (GPLv3) — Linux usermode emulation on iOS. We run [an ARM64 fork](https://github.com/OpenMinis/ish-arm64). - **[PRoot](https://github.com/termux/proot)** (GPLv2) — user-space chroot for the Android sandbox, via [our fork](https://github.com/OpenMinis/proot); **[talloc](https://talloc.samba.org)** (LGPLv3+) underpins it. - **[Alpine Linux](https://alpinelinux.org)** — the minirootfs the sandbox boots. **Media & text** — [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org) (LGPL-2.1+), [LAME](https://lame.sourceforge.io) (LGPL), [cppjieba](https://github.com/yanyiwu/cppjieba) (MIT), [KaTeX](https://katex.org) (MIT). **iOS** — [SwiftAnthropic](https://github.com/jamesrochabrun/SwiftAnthropic), [SwiftMath](https://github.com/mgriebling/SwiftMath), [RealTimeCutVADLibrary](https://github.com/helloooideeeeea/RealTimeCutVADLibrary) (all MIT), [swift-cmark](https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-cmark) (BSD-2-Clause), and the Apple / Swift Server Workgroup packages (Apache-2.0). **Android** — [AndroidX & Jetpack Compose](https://developer.android.com/jetpack), [OkHttp](https://square.github.io/okhttp/), [Coil](https://coil-kt.github.io/coil/), [kotlinx](https://github.com/Kotlin) serialization & coroutines, [multiplatform-markdown-renderer](https://github.com/mikepenz/multiplatform-markdown-renderer), [Reorderable](https://github.com/Calvin-LL/Reorderable), [ACRA](https://github.com/ACRA/acra) (all Apache-2.0), and [Shizuku](https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku-API) (MIT). --- ## License OpenMinis is licensed under the **[GNU General Public License v3.0](LICENSE)**. The app links GPL-licensed components — [iSH](https://github.com/OpenMinis/ish-arm64) (GPLv3) and [PRoot](https://github.com/OpenMinis/proot) (GPLv2) — so the combined work is distributed under GPLv3. Bundled third-party licenses are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). --- ## Community - **Telegram**: [Join the group](https://t.me/+2NzhOJuzRyI1YmM1) - **Issues**: Bug reports, feature requests and discussion via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/OpenMinis/OpenMinis/issues) This repository is a mirror of a private development tree, so it **does not accept pull requests** — there is nowhere for them to land. Issues are the way to shape the product, and [AwesomeMinis](https://github.com/OpenMinis/AwesomeMinis) and [MinisSkills](https://github.com/OpenMinis/MinisSkills) both do take contributions. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
readmeHtml:
OpenMinis

Your private, on-device AI agent.

OpenMinis brings leading models — Claude, GPT, Gemini and more — into a native mobile experience, and gives them a real computer to work with: a full Linux shell running on your device, browser automation, extensible skills, persistent memory, and deep system integration.

It is free, and fully open source.

We believe that in the age of AI, technical design and code are no longer where a product's advantage lies. The best agent emerges from a tight feedback loop with the people who use it — their expectations and their reports are what converge on the product.

Official website: openminis.app

 

What it does
Bring your own model Claude, GPT, Gemini and other providers, via your own API keys or account sign-in.
A real Linux shell A sandboxed Alpine Linux environment runs on-device — the agent can install packages, run scripts, and work with real files.
Device integration Health, Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, HomeKit, Bluetooth, Clipboard, Media, Alarms and more, exposed to the agent as tools.
Browser automation The agent can browse and interact with the web on your behalf.
Skills & memory Extensible skills plus persistent memory across sessions.
Workspaces Organise work into separate contexts, addressable via minis://workspace/.
Native offloads Heavy or platform-specific work is handed to native code instead of the sandbox.

What you can do with Minis

A few things people actually use it for:

  • Photograph a meal, log the nutrition — Minis identifies the dishes, estimates calories and macros, and writes them to Apple Health.
  • Wake up to your timeline — Shortcuts triggers Minis to fetch your X timeline, summarise it, synthesise speech, and play it as your alarm.
  • Turn group chatter into tasks — pull messages from a Telegram group, extract bugs and action items, deduplicate them, and file them into Apple Reminders.
  • Mount your Obsidian vault — research, clean up and write Markdown notes back into the vault as a normal workspace.
  • Share anything into a calendar event — send a page or message to Minis via the iOS Share Sheet and it creates the event, time and place included.

→ OpenMinis/AwesomeMinis — a curated, community-contributed collection of use cases and workflows across health, productivity, research, finance and developer tooling.

Skills

A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file — instructions, and optionally scripts, references and assets — that the agent loads on demand when a request matches it. Metadata stays in context for triggering; the body and bundled resources load only when the skill is actually used.

Minis has its own tool system, but it does not require skills written specifically for it: skills built for Claude, Codex, OpenClaw or Hermes Agent generally run in Minis as-is. Skills that have been adapted to Minis' tools simply run better — they can reach the Linux shell, device integrations and native offloads directly.

→ OpenMinis/MinisSkills — skills adapted for Minis alongside ones built for it from scratch, covering TTS, search, media downloads, health analysis, cloud APIs and more.

Press

"the most impressive indie app I've seen in a while"

— Federico Viticci, Open Minis Is the iOS Agent I Wish Siri AI Could Be, MacStories (July 2026)

"在很大程度上实现甚至局部超越了 Apple Intelligence"

— Ye Han, 这可能是 iPhone 最强 Agent 软件，没有之一 丨Open Minis 入门指南, 知乎 / Zhihu (June 2026)

"可能是 iOS 端最强 AI Agent"

— Open Minis：可能是 iOS 端最强 AI Agent, 小众软件 / Appinn (March 2026)

Beta programme

App Store releases can lag behind: every update waits on review, and we hold builds back when stability warrants it. The TestFlight build is where fixes and new features land first.

→ Join the TestFlight beta

On Android, the releases page always carries the latest APK.

Building from source

Minis ships a Linux sandbox inside the app, so the native dependencies (iSH on iOS, PRoot on Android, FFmpeg, LAME) and the Alpine rootfs are built from source rather than committed as binaries.

→ See BUILDING.md for the full first-build guide.

The short version:

git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/OpenMinis/OpenMinis.git
cd OpenMinis

# iOS  — order matters: FFmpeg links against LAME
./deps/build_lame.sh && ./deps/build_ffmpeg.sh
./deps/build_ish.sh && ./deps/prepare_alpine_rootfs.sh
open src/ios/Minis.xcodeproj

# Android — needs NDK r28+
./deps/build_proot.sh && ./scripts/prepare_android_sandbox.sh
cd src/android && ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug

BUILDING.md covers the toolchain requirements per platform, the build-time customization templates, and a troubleshooting section for the failure modes you are most likely to hit.

Repository layout

src/ios/          iOS app (Swift / SwiftUI) + share, widget and file-provider extensions
src/android/      Android app (Kotlin / Compose) + JNI native code
src/shared/       Assets shared by both platforms
deps/             Native dependency build scripts and vendored sources
docs/specs/       Architecture and interface specifications
scripts/          Rootfs preparation and developer tooling

Acknowledgements

OpenMinis stands on a great deal of open-source work. Our thanks to the maintainers of these projects — the full inventory, with versions and license terms, is in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.

The sandbox — the heart of the product:

  • iSH (GPLv3) — Linux usermode emulation on iOS. We run an ARM64 fork.
  • PRoot (GPLv2) — user-space chroot for the Android sandbox, via our fork; talloc (LGPLv3+) underpins it.
  • Alpine Linux — the minirootfs the sandbox boots.

Media & text — FFmpeg (LGPL-2.1+), LAME (LGPL), cppjieba (MIT), KaTeX (MIT).

iOS — SwiftAnthropic, SwiftMath, RealTimeCutVADLibrary (all MIT), swift-cmark (BSD-2-Clause), and the Apple / Swift Server Workgroup packages (Apache-2.0).

Android — AndroidX & Jetpack Compose, OkHttp, Coil, kotlinx serialization & coroutines, multiplatform-markdown-renderer, Reorderable, ACRA (all Apache-2.0), and Shizuku (MIT).

License

OpenMinis is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

The app links GPL-licensed components — iSH (GPLv3) and PRoot (GPLv2) — so the combined work is distributed under GPLv3. Bundled third-party licenses are listed in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.

Community

  • Telegram: Join the group
  • Issues: Bug reports, feature requests and discussion via GitHub Issues

This repository is a mirror of a private development tree, so it does not accept pull requests — there is nowhere for them to land. Issues are the way to shape the product, and AwesomeMinis and MinisSkills both do take contributions. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

releases.name: Android 0.20-preview
releases.body:
## Highlights / 重点

- **全新思考强度体系**：新增 GPT-5.6 Sol / Terra / Luna 模型;思考强度扩展到 Max / Ultra 档;每个模型只显示它真正支持的档位;跨模型切换时思考强度无缝保留;选择器改为横向滚动、蓝色高亮、更紧凑。
  A reworked thinking-strength system — adds GPT-5.6 Sol / Terra / Luna, extends intensity up to Max / Ultra, shows only the tiers each model actually supports, preserves your setting seamlessly across model switches, and gives the picker a scrollable, blue-highlighted, more compact layout.
- **Claude 思考文本现可正常显示**：走 Claude（OAuth）的 Claude 4.6+ 模型（Sonnet 5、Opus 4.x）开启思考强度后,界面现在能看到思考摘要文本,而不再是空白。
  Claude thinking text now shows — on Claude 4.6+ models (Sonnet 5, Opus 4.x) over Claude OAuth, enabling reasoning now displays the summarized thinking text instead of nothing.
- **Android 16 灵动岛 / 实时状态**：在 Android 16 设备上可把 Minis 的实时任务状态显示到系统状态胶囊（"灵动岛"）;开启后自动隐藏悬浮窗胶囊,避免两套状态 UI 重复。
  Android 16 Live Updates / "dynamic island" — on Android 16 devices, Minis' live task status can surface on the system status chip; enabling it hides the floating overlay so you never see two status indicators at once.

## 新功能 / New features

- 新增 GPT-5.6 Sol / Terra / Luna 模型（Codex OAuth）。
  Added GPT-5.6 Sol / Terra / Luna models (Codex OAuth).
- 思考强度新增 Max / Ultra 档,并按当前模型上限

releases.name: Android 0.19-preview
releases.body:
## Highlights / 重点

- **会话标题生成全面改进**：可在会话编辑面板手动「重新生成标题」；标题生成改用首尾消息对作为上下文、优先使用专用子模型、并统一了推理/温度设置，标题更贴切稳定。
  Big improvements to session title generation — a manual "Regenerate Title" button in the session edit sheet, titles now use the first+last message pair as context, prefer the dedicated sub-model, and share unified reasoning/temperature settings.
- **Azure OpenAI 支持**：OpenAI 实例新增 Azure OpenAI 模式。
  Added Azure OpenAI mode for OpenAI instances.
- **Claude 上下文窗口修正为 1M**：现代 Claude 模型的上下文窗口更正为 100 万 tokens（此前误标为 20 万）。
  Corrected modern Claude context windows to 1M tokens (previously mislabeled as 200K).

## 新功能 / New features

- 会话编辑面板新增「重新生成标题」按钮（与 iOS 对齐）。
  New "Regenerate Title" button in the session edit sheet (iOS parity).
- OpenAI 实例支持 Azure OpenAI 模式。
  Azure OpenAI mode for OpenAI instances.
- 模型组标题旁按优先级标记该组的前两项模态（输入 + 输出）图标。
  Each Model Group now marks its top-2 modalities (inputs + outputs) by priority.
- model-use 支持为 OpenAI 兼容图像模型透传 body / headers / endpoint-path。
  model-use now passes through body / headers / endpoint-path for OpenAI-compatible image models.

## 修复 / Fixes

- 压缩（compact）成功后，排队中的提示现会自动继续执行。
  Queued prompts now run automatically after a successful c

releases.name: Android 0.18-preview
releases.body:
## Highlights / 重点

- **新增 Claude Sonnet 5**：Anthropic 模型目录已加入 Claude Sonnet 5。
  Added Claude Sonnet 5 to the Anthropic model catalog.
- **超长思考不再卡死界面**：思考内容采用窗口化渲染（只渲染尾部 + 超大内容用原生查看器），数万字的推理过程也不再冻结 UI。
  Long "thinking" blocks no longer freeze the UI — thinking content is now windowed (tail-only rendering, with a native viewer for very large content).
- **错误状态可跨会话保留**：助手消息的错误提示 + 重试按钮在重新加载会话后依然存在，不再消失。
  Assistant error banners + Retry now survive a session reload instead of vanishing.

## 新功能 / New features

- 聊天「…」菜单新增置顶的「新建对话」入口。
  "New Chat" added as the first item in the chat overflow menu.
- 长按「新建对话」FAB 可用指定模型组直接开启会话；长按菜单显示模型组的模态摘要。
  Long-press the "New Chat" FAB to start a session with a specific model group; the long-press menu shows the group's modality summary.
- 新增「增强缓存」开关（Anthropic 1 小时缓存 TTL），与 iOS 对齐。
  New "Enhanced Cache" toggle (1h Anthropic cache TTL), matching iOS.
- 「添加服务商」页面每个协议下方改为显示所支持的典型厂商说明（而非内置模型数量）。
  The Add Provider picker now describes which vendors each protocol supports instead of a raw model count.
- OpenAI 兼容图像生成新增 ImageEndpointMode，可正确处理输入图像的图像生成。
  Added ImageEndpointMode for OpenAI-compatible image generation, including input-image image-gen.

releases.name: Android 0.17-preview
releases.body:
## Highlights / 重点

- **流式输出体验全面对齐 iOS**：文字逐词淡入、按"时间或换行"双策略分段刷新（逐行连续流出而非整段蹦），视口缓动跟随到底部。
  Streaming output now feels like iOS — word-by-word fade-in, a dual-path (time-or-newline) flush that reveals text line-by-line instead of in dead chunks, and an ease-out viewport glide that follows the bottom smoothly.
- **会话列表新增「后台暂停」角标**：任务在后台被系统中断后，回到会话列表会在该会话图标上显示 ⏸ 角标，点进会话后消失；冷启动 / 进程被杀后也能恢复显示。
  New "paused" badge in the session list — when a task is interrupted in the background, the session shows a ⏸ badge until you reopen it; it survives cold start / process kill too.

## 新功能 / New features

- 流式 Markdown 逐词淡入动画。
  Word-by-word fade-in for streaming Markdown.
- 流式输出时视口平滑缓动跟随到底部（替代生硬的瞬间跳到底）。
  Smooth ease-out viewport follow during streaming, replacing the abrupt snap-to-bottom.
- 会话列表「后台暂停」⏸ 角标，带持久化与冷启动恢复。
  Session-list "paused" ⏸ badge, persisted and restored across cold start.

## 修复 / Fixes

- 流式文字改为逐行连续刷新，不再每隔一段时间整段蹦出。
  Streaming text now reveals line-by-line instead of jumping out in time-stepped chunks.
- 加固流式在被中断 / 停止 / 重试 / 清空会话等非正常结束时的状态处理，避免停止后残留「思考中」状态行或丢失末尾文字。

releases.name: Android 0.15-preview
releases.body:
## 重点亮点 / Highlights

- 🚀 **冷启动大提速**：provider 配置改为后台加载，原先卡 >11 秒（SharedPrefs + JSON 解码同步阻塞 onCreate）现在秒开。
  **Cold-start unblocked**: provider config now loads off the main thread; previously a synchronous SharedPrefs + JSON decode hung `onCreate` >11s on devices with many providers, now boots instantly.
- 🛡️ **崩溃循环防护**：连续多次 crash_or_stall 后冷启动不再自动恢复到上次会话，避免再次撞上同一个卡死的超长会话。
  **Crash-loop safety net**: after consecutive crash_or_stall cycles, cold-start lands on the session list instead of auto-recovering — protects against repeatedly re-entering a session that's killing the process.
- 📜 **超长会话尾部窗口化**：300+ 条消息的会话只渲染最近 200 条，顶部「加载更早」按需扩展窗口。Larky-class 1.9MB 会话也能流畅打开。
  **Long-session tail-window**: chats with 300+ messages render only the most-recent 200; an "↑ Load older messages" header expands the window in steps. Larky-class 1.9 MB sessions now open smoothly.
- 🔧 **minis-config 可加 provider 和写 API key**：agent 可通过 minis-config 创建新 provider、写入 apiKey（字面值或 `$$ENV_VAR` 引用），凭证读取仍受 permission_denied 守卫，能写不能读。

aiSummary.oneLiner: A free, open-source AI agent application designed to run seamlessly across multiple platforms.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: OpenMinis is a cross-platform application that brings AI agents directly to the user's device. Built with Swift, it provides a native, responsive interface for interacting with various AI models and customized agents. The project emphasizes being fully free and open-source, allowing users to run personal assistants, coding helpers, or task automation bots without relying on proprietary, closed-ecosystem apps. It aims to democratize access to agentic AI through a polished, accessible client.
keyFeatures: Cross-platform support: Designed to provide a consistent AI agent experience across different operating systems.
Native Swift performance: Built with Swift to ensure a fast, fluid, and battery-efficient user interface.
Open-source ecosystem: Fully free and transparent, allowing community contributions and independent auditing.
Customizable agents: Users can configure and run distinct AI agents tailored to specific tasks.
Local execution options: Supports connecting to local LLMs to ensure data privacy and offline capabilities.

useCases.title: Personal AI assistant
useCases.description: Users install the app on their devices to have a privacy-respecting, always-available AI assistant for drafting emails, answering questions, and summarizing documents.

useCases.title: Cross-device agent syncing
useCases.description: Professionals use the application across their phone and laptop to maintain a consistent context and chat history with their specialized AI agents.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: End-users seeking a free, open-source alternative to commercial AI apps, as well as developers who want to contribute to a cross-platform Swift-based AI client.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Clone the repository and build the project using Xcode for Apple platforms.
